prompts: Create a production 16-bit pixel-art game environment sprite atlas, transparent background, 1024x1024, EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows of equal 256x256 cells. Every cell isolated, generous transparent margins, no text, no border, no grid lines. For Bullets of Fury Overdrive, gritty Neo Geo / Sega Genesis military sci-fi base, dark iron, desaturated gray concrete, rust, crisp pixel clusters, no blur, no anti-aliased painterly edges. Camera is elevated top-down orthographic like a topdown shooter, north at top, axis-aligned rectangular objects. NOT isometric diamond or diagonal. Each object has a LARGE VISIBLE TOP PLANE occupying roughly the upper 40 percent, plus raised FRONT VERTICAL FACE in lower 60 percent and a modest contact shadow beneath. Actual visible volume like crates sitting on floor, never flat face decals. Light from upper left. Each row is ONE IDENTICAL OBJECT through four damage states with fixed camera, footprint, size and bottom ground contact. Column1 intact, column2 visibly dented/cracked, column3 heavily broken but still standing, column4 collapsed debris with same footprint. Row1 low broad armored concrete cover wall, broad rectangle 200px wide and 100px total high, top horizontal slab 30px deep, segmented charcoal metal front with chipped yellow hazard stripe. Row2 taller wide bunker barricade 200px wide and 140px high, deep top slab 50px, steel braces, grille and rusty studs. Row3 tall stacked steel military cargo crates, rectangular stack 138px wide and 168px high, visible top lid, straps, rusty blue-gray panels and recessed dark front, NO weapons/characters. Row4 red-black fuel barrel, 82px wide and 136px high, VISIBLE ELLIPTICAL TOP with bung, vertical cylinder, metal bands, subtle yellow danger symbol. Each row use same proportional scale through damage states, bottom ground contact at cell y=220, horizontal center x=128. Edge pixels sharply opaque, preserve transparency outside objects.

Create a second production 16-bit pixel-art object atlas for a gritty military sci-fi top-down shooter. Transparent background 1024x1024, exact 4x4 uniform 256px cells. NO text, grid, labels, characters. Crisp small pixel clusters like Neo Geo / Sega Genesis, dark industrial charcoal, weathered olive steel, brown rust, selective cyan and red lights; no smooth rendering, no glow fog, no blur. Elevated TOP-DOWN ORTHOGRAPHIC camera, no isometric diagonal geometry: every rectangular object aligns to screen vertical/horizontal. Visible large top plane, front vertical face, grounded contact shadow, high relief depth. Four damage states per row, same identity shape footprint camera and bottom anchor through whole row. Columns intact, chipped/dented, badly damaged, destroyed debris. Row1 TALL vertical north-south concrete wall section, footprint long north-south, 76px wide, total height188px, show top surface long going straight up the screen, front end face and narrow shaded right side; it must read as a thick upright wall with height not a floor tile. Row2 wooden supply crate stack, width140px totalheight156px, 45px deep visible top lid, strong 3D volume without diagonal/isometric layout, steel straps. Row3 industrial generator/server cabinet, width118px totalheight158px, 45px visible top surface, rusty iron front grille, small cyan status lights and pipes, rectangular raised machine. Row4 red alarm relay bollard, width96px totalheight148px, broad raised steel pedestal with visible top, red domed rotating siren on pedestal, machinery box with vents. Every cell center x128, bottom ground contact y220. No objects spill into neighbors, clear transparent gutters. Authored game sprites, sharp alpha edges.

Create a seamless repeating 256x256 pixel art floor texture for a gritty 16-bit top-down military sci-fi base. It tiles in both axes with no visible seam. Full opaque square. Orthographic directly overhead FLOOR MATERIAL ONLY, large dark gray industrial concrete slabs with narrow steel inlaid channels, restrained rust at seams, a few hairline cracks, very subtle oil grime. Neo Geo / Sega Genesis pixel clusters, restrained 12-color palette, dark desaturated blue-gray, charcoal and muted rust. Crisp exact pixel edges, no blur, no soft lighting gradient, no perspective, no props, no doors, no wall, no text, no symbols, no repeated bright accents. Floor brightness around 25-35 percent so red-clothed player and enemies stand out. Slab panels 64px by64px, weathering remains subdued. Do not make a shiny photorealistic surface.

Generate ONE row of FOUR game sprite cells, 1024x256 total, transparent background. Gritty 16-bit Neo Geo pixel art. Each 256x256 cell contains the SAME military wooden supply crate stack through damage states: intact, chipped, badly broken, collapsed debris. Camera is a top-down shooter elevated orthographic camera looking down at 55 degrees, NOT eye-level frontal. The intact crate is a solid RECTANGULAR CUBOID with a LARGE VISIBLE TOP LID occupying the top HALF of the object's image, showing brown wooden PLANKS and dark steel reinforcing straps. The raised front vertical face is the bottom HALF, much darker. Screen aligned square footprint, horizontal front edge and vertical side edges, NO isometric diamond. Two stacked boxes; top face and front face visibly distinct, looks raised well above ground, not a flat board or fence. Strong small cast shadow underneath to bottom right. Weathered dark olive/brown wood, gray steel hinges and rivets, amber scratches, bold 1 pixel dark edge, crisp pixel clusters. Each object about176px wide and190px high, bottom ground contact y232, center128. Same scale and fixed bottom contact across damage states, clear alpha gutters. No ground tile, no words, no labels. Damaged states preserve the cube's top surface and height until last cell collapsed. Pixel art not smooth or painted, no anti-alias or glow.
